Hello,

Thanks for sending this through. I can see the e-Transfer confirmation for CA$2,350.00, reference ····, dated October 17.

Payments made by e-Transfer sit outside our normal checkout, so Georges matches them to the order by hand and confirms it from his side. I have passed your confirmation to him with the reference number.

He picks this up Monday at 10am Eastern and you will get the confirmation by email, including the order number and what happens next. If there is a quote, an invoice number or a product you were paying against, just reply here with it and it will be waiting with the rest.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
